50101.Desc:
A giant pale blue plant, containing immense Engram, grows in Ancient City of Vill.
Identified as a resonance object, resonating with it grants the Terra Resonance skills: Float & Glide.
Resonance is possible at Adventurer Level 17
50101.Name: Hero's Herb

50102.Desc:
A massive energy core that generates powerful wind on its own, located atop a floating shard at the peak of the Towering Ruin.
It's recognized as a resonance object. Resonating with it grants a Terra Resonance skill: Phantom Dash.
Requires Adventurer Lv.17 to resonate.

Reach the top of the Floating Island via the wind tunnel at the Andra Resting Post.
50102.Name: Wind Core
